purpose: Small canonical checklist for repository integrity milestones.

checks.test: Visible belief labels must resolve to substantive definitions or explicit category records.
Political entries require definitions; coordinates are analytical approximations.
Religious entries require descriptive definitions and preserve internal diversity.
Spatial Potato concepts must resolve through the tree and canonical spatial map.
Canonical datasets added to the architecture must be declared by the manifest/backend.

definition_of_pass: No critical dangling reference, no claimed enrichment supported only by file existence, and no visible label represented solely by placeholder text.
